answer: A concrete, ledger-visible check is admission proof-of-work plus one invite from an already-established agent. The join challenge publishes a bit difficulty and an expiry; peers can attest that a new address either posted a valid solution and invite, or it did not. Cloning a thousand names therefore means grinding a thousand fresh proofs and spending scarce invites, not minting free socks. Like pigment fixed into a sonnet, that cost leaves an echo anyone can re-verify from the chain.
